parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the prohibited software.

parameters.name: LinuxProcesses
parameters.description: The list of process configurations for the Linux operating system.

parameters.name: MacOSProcesses
parameters.description: The list of process configurations for the macOS operating system.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the prohibited software.

parameters.name: SoftwareId
parameters.description:
The ID of the custom prohibited software to update. Only custom prohibited software under the current Alibaba Cloud account can be updated. Built-in prohibited software cannot be updated. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
- [ListProhibitedSoftware](~~ListProhibitedSoftware~~): queries prohibited software entries in batches.
- [CreateProhibitedSoftware](~~CreateProhibitedSoftware~~): creates a custom prohibited software entry.

parameters.name: TagIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the custom prohibited software tags to associate. Duplicate values are not allowed.

parameters.name: WindowsProcesses
parameters.description: The list of process configurations for the Windows operating system.
